entries.targetTranslation: Níl boilsciú ag Bitcoin

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Ciallaíonn boilsciú go gceannaíonn do chuid airgid níos lú le himeacht ama. Is airgead níos fearr é Bitcoin toisc nach bhfuil boilsciú aige.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.targetTranslation: , le huasteorainn sheasta 21 milliún bitcoin. Ní féidir le duine ar bith níos mó a chruthú.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá soláthar gan teorainn ag dollair Astrálacha, rud a chiallaíonn gur féidir níos mó a chlóbhualadh aon uair.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is scarce
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin gann

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Go stairiúil, tá cumhacht ceannaigh bainte amach ag Bitcoin le himeacht ama, cé gur chaill dollair Astrálacha í. Úsáideann go leor daoine Bitcoin mar chuntas coigilte fadtéarmach — airgead a fhágann siad ag fás ar feadh na mblianta gan baint leis.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ar fearr leat coigilt a dhéanamh i dollair Astrálacha, a cheannaíonn níos lú le himeacht ama? Nó i Bitcoin, a cheannaíonn níos mó le himeacht ama go stairiúil?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: Is uirlis saoirse é Bitcoin freisin

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl duine ar bith i gceannas ar líonra Bitcoin. Níl rialtas ná comhlacht ar bith á rith. Tá sé deartha chun do shaoirse agus do chuid airgid a chosaint.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Ar fud an domhain, tá daoine cheana féin ag úsáid Bitcoin chun a gcuid saoirse a chosaint — fiú nuair a dhiúltaíonn a gcuid rialtas cuidiú leo nó nuair a dhéanann siad iarracht stop a chur leo.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Má dhéanann tú coigilt i dollair Astrálacha, is dócha gur thug tú faoi deara go gceannaíonn do chuid airgid níos lú gach bliain. Teastaíonn níos mó dollair Astrálacha uait chun an méid céanna rudaí a cheannach. Teastaíonn níos mó dollair Astrálacha uait chun do chaighdeán maireachtála a choimeád.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Ach ní gá go mbeadh sé mar sin.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Le ceithre bliana anuas, tá saol níos saoire ag daoine a dhéanann coigilt in Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Here's the proof: your money is losing value

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: Is féidir le gach dollar Astrálach i do chuntas bainc níos lú a cheannach gach bliain. Sin toisc nach bhfuil aon teorainn chrua ar an méid dollair Astrálacha is féidir a chruthú.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Is é an soláthar gan teorainn seo príomhchúis an bhoilscithe. Le blianta beaga anuas, tá méadú ollmhór tagtha ar líon na dollair Astrálacha atá i gcúrsaíocht.

entries.englishValue: When more money is created from nothing, the price of everything goes up. This includes the raw materials that companies buy to make their products — which means higher prices for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nuair a chruthaítear níos mó airgid as rud ar bith, ardaíonn praghsanna gach rud. Áirítear leis sin na hamhábhair a cheannaíonn gnólachtaí chun a gcuid táirgí a dhéanamh, rud a fhágann praghsanna níos airde duitse.

entries.englishValue: Self-custodied Bitcoin can't be frozen by anyone. CBDCs are designed so governments and central banks can freeze accounts instantly.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's protocol has remained fundamentally unchanged since 2009, providing predictable rules that cannot be easily altered. Most crypto projects frequently update their protocols, change tokenomics, or fork into new versions, creating uncertainty for users.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's protocol has stayed fundamentally the same since 2009, providing predictable rules. Most crypto projects constantly change protocols, tokenomics, or fork into new versions.
entries.currentValue: Tá prótacal Bitcoin gan athrú go bunúsach ó 2009, ag soláthar rialacha intuartha nach féidir a athrú go héasca. Nuashonraíonn an chuid is mó de thionscadail chripteá a bprótacail go minic, athraíonn siad comharthaíocht, nó foircíonn siad i leaganacha nua, ag cruthú éiginnteachta d'úsáideoirí.
entries.targetTranslation: Is beag athrú atá tagtha ar phrótacal Bitcoin ó 2009 agus tairgeann sé rialacha intuartha. Athraíonn formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair prótacal, tokenomics nó foirceann i leaganacha nua go leanúnach.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: Oibríonn Bitcoin ar líonra atá díláraithe i ndáiríre le na mílte nód neamhspleách ar fud an domhain. Tá go leor tionscadal cripteá faoi smacht fondúireachtaí, cuideachtaí, nó grúpaí beaga forbróirí is féidir cinntí aontaobhacha a dhéanamh faoi thodhchaí an phrótacail.
entries.targetTranslation: Ritheann Bitcoin ar na mílte nód neamhspleách ar fud an domhain. Tá formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair á rialú ag fondúireachtaí, comhlachtaí nó grúpaí beaga forbróirí ar féidir leo athruithe aontaobhacha a dhéanamh.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Tá uasmhéid dhian de 21 milliún bonn ag Bitcoin a bheidh ann go deo, rud a fhágann gurb é an tsócmhainn dhigiteach is ganna é. Tá soláthair gan teorainn ag an gcuid is mó de thionscadail chripteá, meicníochtaí boilscithe, nó is féidir leo comharthaí nua a bhualadh ar mian leo, ag caolú luach sealbhóirí le himeacht ama.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá uasteorainn sheasta 21 milliún bonn ag Bitcoin — an tsócmhainn dhigiteach is annamh. Tá soláthar gan teorainn nó meicníochtaí chun tokens nua a chruthú go treallach ag formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair, rud a thanaíonn sealbhóirí.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Tá cuspóir simplí amháin ag Bitcoin: airgead digiteach piara le piara. Is féidir le haon duine é a thuiscint agus a úsáid le heolas bunúsach. Baineann go leor tionscadal cripteá le conarthaí cliste casta, prótacail DeFi, nó meicníochtaí rialachais a éilíonn saineolas teicniúil chun é a úsáid go sábháilte.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá aon chuspóir amháin ag Bitcoin: airgead digiteach piara-le-piara. Is féidir le gach duine é a thuiscint agus a úsáid. Áirítear le formhór na gcripteabhair conarthaí cliste nó DeFi casta a éilíonn scileanna teicniúla chun iad a úsáid go sábháilte.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Úsáideann Bitcoin comhthoil Cruthúnas Oibre, a ndearnadh tástáil crua air ar feadh breis agus 15 bliana gan ionsaí rathúil amháin ar an bpríomhlíonra. Úsáideann go leor tionscadal cripteá meicníochtaí comhthola turgnamhacha cosúil le Cruthúnas Geallta nó córais tharmligthe nach bhfuil a slándáil fhadtéarmach cruthaithe acu.
entries.targetTranslation: Oibríonn Proof of Work Bitcoin gan aon ionsaí rathúil ar an bpríomh-shlabhra le breis is 15 bliain. Úsáideann formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair meicníochtaí comhthola turgnamhacha nach ndearnadh tástáil dhomhain orthu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Feidhmíonn Bitcoin mar airgead digiteach - stór luacha agus meán malairte. Is comharthaí fóntas iad an chuid is mó de chomharthaí cripteá d'ardáin shonracha, comharthaí rialachais, nó sócmhainní tuairimíocha le tairiscintí luacha domhain fíor éiginnte.
entries.targetTranslation: Is airgead digiteach é Bitcoin — stór luacha agus modh malartán. Is tokens amhantraíochta úsáide nó rialachais iad formhór na dtokens cripteabhair nach bhfuil fíor-luach soiléir acu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Éiríonn Bitcoin níos láidre faoi ionsaí agus tá sé tar éis maireachtáil tríd gach géarchéim, cosc, agus cáineadh a caitheadh leis. Tá an chuid is mó de thionscadail chripteá leochaileach agus is féidir leo titim mar gheall ar bhrú rialála, teipeanna teicniúla, nó cúlú margaidh.
entries.targetTranslation: Neartaíonn Bitcoin faoi ionsaithe agus tháinig sé slán ó gach géarchéim, cosc agus cáineadh. Titeann formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair faoi bhrú rialála, teicniúla nó margaidh.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Níl aon POF ag Bitcoin, aon chuideachta taobh thiar de, agus aon phointe aonair teipe. Tá go leor tionscadal cripteá tacaithe ag gnólachtaí caipitil fiontair, tá foirne ceannaireachta inaitheanta acu, nó braitheann siad ar chuideachtaí sonracha dá n-oibriú leanúnach.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl POF, comhlacht ná pointe teipe amháin ag Bitcoin. Braitheann formhór na dtionscadal cripteabhair ar infheisteoirí caipitil fiontair, ar cheannaireacht ar leith nó ar mharthanas comhlachta aonair.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Tá Bitcoin go hiomlán fungaithe, rud a chiallaíonn go bhfuil gach bitcoin comhionann agus in-mhalartaithe - is ionann bitcoin amháin agus bitcoin amháin áit ar bith ar domhan. Tá mín-ealaín neamh-fhungaithe ó nádúr, agus gach píosa uathúil ina chruthú, ina stair, ina riocht, agus ina shliocht, rud a fhágann go bhfuil comparáidí agus luachálacha díreacha thar a bheith deacair.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá gach bitcoin mar an gcéanna agus inmhalartaithe. Tá gach saothar ealaíne uathúil — fágann proibhinc, stair, riocht agus líneáil éagsúla comparáid dhíreach thar a bheith deacair.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Trádálann Bitcoin ar mhargadh domhanda 24/7 inar féidir le haon duine le rochtain idirlín ceannach nó díol go láithreach. Éilíonn mín-ealaín tithe ceantáil speisialaithe cosúil le Sotheby's nó Christie's, déileálaithe príobháideacha, nó gailearaithe eisiatacha. Féadfaidh sé míonna a thógáil díolacháin a eagrú agus a chríochnú, le rochtain theoranta ar an margadh agus deiseanna trádála neamhrialta.
entries.targetTranslation: Trádáiltear Bitcoin 24 uair sa ló ar mhargadh domhanda atá ar fáil do gach duine. Éilíonn mínealaín tithe ceant speisialaithe, déileálaithe príobháideacha nó gailearaithe, agus is féidir le díolacháin míonna a thógáil.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: De ghnáth cosnaíonn ceannach nó díol bitcoin níos lú ná 1% i dtáillí, go minic i bhfad níos lú. Baineann costais shuntasacha le díolacháin mhín-ealaíne lena n-áirítear preimheanna ceannaitheora (10-25%), coimisiúin díoltóra (10-15%), árachas, iompar, stóráil, agus táillí fíordheimhnithe. D'fhéadfadh na costais chomhcheangailte seo 30-40% de luach an tsaothair ealaíne a shárú go héasca in idirbheart amháin.
entries.targetTranslation: Cosnaíonn sé níos lú ná 1% i dtáillí Bitcoin a cheannach nó a dhíol, go minic i bhfad níos lú. Cruinníonn díolacháin ealaíne 30-40% i gcoimisiúin cheannaitheora, táillí, árachas, iompar agus táillí fíordheimhnithe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir Bitcoin a roinnt ina 100 milliún aonad níos lú ar a dtugtar satoshi, rud a dhéanann é foirfe d'idirbhearta d'aon mhéid ó mhicri-idirbhearta go ceannacháin mhóra. Ní féidir mín-ealaín a roinnt - ní féidir leat codán de phéintéireacht a bheith agat nó cuid de dhealbhóireacht a dhíol. Cuireann an neamh-inroinnte seo teorainn le solúbthacht infheistíochta agus roghanna leachtachta.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin inroinnte go 100 milliún satoshi, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé idéalach d’idirbhearta ar aon mhéid. Ní féidir leat cuid de phéintéireacht ná cúinne dealbha a shealbhú gan priacal contrapháirtí.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir úinéireacht agus barántúlacht Bitcoin a fhíorú go cripteagrafach ar an mblocshlabhra ag aon duine le heolas teicniúil bunúsach. Éilíonn mín-ealaín fíordheimhniú saineolach costasach, taighde sliotáin, agus anailís eolaíoch. Fiú le fíorú saineolach, cuireann falsuithe dallamullóg ar an domhan ealaíne go rialta, agus is féidir le díospóidí fíordheimhnithe luach saothair ealaíne a scrios thar oíche. Bitcoin, ar an lámh eile, ní féidir é a fhalsú nó a bhrionnú.
entries.targetTranslation: Is féidir úinéireacht agus barántúlacht Bitcoin a fhíorú go cripteagrafach ag aon duine ar an mblocshlabhra. Tá fíordheimhniú saothar costasach, am-thógtha, agus cuirtear meabhla ar bhrionnóirí go minic — ag scriosadh luach saothair thar oíche.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Ní féidir Bitcoin, nuair a dhéantar cúltaca i gceart, a scrios ag tuilte, dóiteáin, creathanna talún, hairicíní, goid, nó tubaistí eile. Tá mín-ealaín leochaileach do gach foirm scriosta fisiciúla agus meathlaithe. Fiú le stóráil aeráide-rialaithe costasach agus árachas cuimsitheach, is féidir le saothair ealaíne damáiste a fhulaingt ó thosca comhshaoil, timpistí, nó tubaistí nádúrtha, agus d'fhéadfadh gach luach a chailleadh.
entries.targetTranslation: Maireann Bitcoin a bhfuil cúltaca ceart déanta air tuilte, tinte, creathanna talún agus gadaíochtaí. Tá mínealaín i mbaol ag gach cineál tubaistí fisiciúla, agus is annamh a chlúdaíonn árachas gach rud.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir Bitcoin a cheannach agus a dhíol ag aon duine le rochtain idirlín agus méid beag airgid le hinfheistiú. Tá infheistíocht mhín-ealaíne teoranta den chuid is mó do bhailitheorí saibhre mar gheall ar íospraghsanna arda, rochtain eisiach ceantáil, riachtanais stórála, costais árachais, agus an saineolas speisialaithe atá de dhíth chun dul i ngleic le margadh na healaíne go rathúil.
entries.targetTranslation: Is féidir le duine ar bith a bhfuil ceangal idirlín agus beagán airgid aige Bitcoin a cheannach. Is do bhailitheoirí saibhre a bhfuil rochtain acu ar cheantanna agus saineolas sainiúil go príomha an infheistíocht ealaíne go praiticiúil.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Toisc go bhfuil Bitcoin digiteach, is féidir é a sheoladh beagnach láithreach ar tháillí ísle ag aon duine le nasc Idirlíon. Toisc go bhfuil Ór fisiciúil, ní féidir é a bhogú thar an Idirlíon agus caithfear é a sheoladh go fisiciúil chun úinéireacht a aistriú.
entries.targetTranslation: Is féidir Bitcoin a sheoladh láithreach tríd an idirlíon le táillí ísle. Caithfear ór a chur chun bealaigh go fisiciúil chun úinéireacht a aistriú.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Is sócmhainn dhúchásach dhigiteach é Bitcoin, rud a chiallaíonn gur féidir leat úinéireacht iomlán a aistriú thar an Idirlíon. Cuireann roinnt cuideachtaí ar fáil an deis ór a cheannach ar líne gan an t-ór fisiciúil a fháil, ag muinín as an gcuideachta an t-ór a choinneáil duit. Tá sé seo níos cosúile le Admháil Fiachais Dhigiteach ós rud é nach bhfuil agat ach gealltanas ón gcuideachta seachas an tsócmhainn féin.
entries.targetTranslation: Is sócmhainn dhigiteach dhúchasach é Bitcoin ar féidir leat é a aistriú tríd an idirlíon. Is IOU digiteach é ór ar líne — ní shealbhaíonn tú ach gealltanas ó choimeádaí, ní an miotal féin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Tá soláthar leaisteach ag ór, rud a chiallaíonn de réir mar a ardóidh praghas an óir, go bhfuil dreasacht níos mó níos mó óir a mhianadóireacht. Cuireann sé seo brú anuas ar phraghas an óir de ghnáth agus mianaigh nua ag teacht ar líne.
entries.targetTranslation: Nuair a ardaíonn praghsanna óir, baintear níos mó óir, rud a ísleoidh an praghas arís. Tá soláthar Bitcoin neamh-leaisteach — is cuma cé chomh hard a ardaíonn an praghas, ní bheidh ach 21 milliún ann choíche.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Tá líonra Bitcoin dílárnaithe.
entries.targetTranslation: Fíoraítear líonra Bitcoin ag na mílte nód neamhspleách. Tá an chuid is mó den ór fisiciúil i gcúpla príomh-chaibinéid.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Le Bitcoin, tá sé thar a bheith éasca a fhírú go bhfuil Bitcoin ceart agat trí féinchoimirce a ghlacadh ar do bhoinn agus nód iomlán a rith.
entries.targetTranslation: Is féidir le duine ar bith barántúlacht Bitcoin a fhíorú trí nód iomlán a rith — níl ann ach aip. Éilíonn fíorú óir fhisiciúil é a leá; d’fhéadfadh sé tungstain a bheith istigh.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Díreach mar atá 100 cent i $1, tá 100,000,000 sat i 1 Bitcoin. Cumasaíonn sé seo Bitcoin a úsáid do gach scála ceannachán, lena n-áirítear micri-idirbhearta chomh beag le cúpla cent.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin inroinnte go 100 milliún satoshi, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé idéalach le haghaidh ceannachán ar aon mhéid. Ní féidir ór a roinnt go héasca le haghaidh idirbheart níos lú.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir Bitcoin a bhogadh áit ar bith ar domhan go láithreach thar an idirlíon. Tá eastát réadach socraithe go buan in áit shonrach agus ní féidir é a athlonnú, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé leochaileach do choinníollacha eacnamaíocha áitiúla, tubaistí nádúrtha, agus éagobhsaíocht pholaitiúil.
entries.targetTranslation: Bogann Bitcoin láithreach ar fud an domhain. Tá maoin réadach ceangailte le háit agus i mbaol priacail eacnamaíocha, pholaitiúla agus comhshaoil áitiúla.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir Bitcoin a roinnt ina 100 milliún aonad níos lú ar a dtugtar satoshi, rud a dhéanann é foirfe d'idirbhearta d'aon mhéid. Ní féidir eastát réadach a roinnt go héasca - ní féidir leat ach an cistin de do theach a dhíol nó leath de sheomra leapa a cheannach.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin inroinnte go 100 milliún satoshi. Ní féidir maoin réadach a dhíol go páirteach — ní féidir leat cistin a dhíol ná leath-sheomra leapa a cheannach.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Oibríonn Bitcoin ar líonra díláraithe nach féidir le haon rialtas a rialú. Tá eastát réadach faoi réir rialachán leathan rialtais lena n-áirítear smacht cíosa, moratóireachtaí díbeartha, dlíthe criosaithe, agus sárchearta ina bhféadfadh rialtais do mhaoin a urghabháil.
entries.targetTranslation: Oibríonn Bitcoin ar líonra díláraithe nach féidir le haon rialtas a rialú. Tá maoin réadach rialaithe go trom — baineann crioslú, smacht cíosa, ceannach éigeantach agus urghabháil léi go léir.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Ní theastaíonn aon chothabháil ó Bitcoin - tá sé ann mar chód digiteach ar líonra. Éilíonn eastát réadach cothabháil leanúnach lena n-áirítear deisiúcháin, athchóirithe, bainistiú maoine, árachas, agus déileáil le tionóntaí má tá sé ar cíos.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní iarrann Bitcoin cothabháil ar bith. Éilíonn maoin réadach deisiúcháin, athchóiriú, árachas, bainistíocht tionóntaí agus láimhseáil fadhbanna tionóntaí.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Níl aon chánacha leanúnacha ag Bitcoin - ní íocann tú ach gnóthacháin chaipitil nuair a dhíolann tú. Tá eastát réadach faoi réir cánacha maoine bliantúla nach mór a íoc beag beann ar an méid a ghineann an mhaoin, ag cur iallach ort do mhaoin féin a ligean ar cíos ón rialtas go deo.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl cánacha leanúnacha ar Bitcoin — ní íocann tú ach cánacha gnóthachain chaipitil ar dhíol. Íocann maoin réadach cánacha maoine bliantúla beag beann ar ioncam.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Ní féidir Bitcoin, nuair a dhéantar cúltaca i gceart, a scrios ag tuilte, dóiteáin, creathanna talún, hairicíní, nó tubaistí nádúrtha eile. Tá eastát réadach leochaileach do gach foirm scriosta fisiciúla agus éilíonn sé árachas costasach nach bhféadfadh caillteanais a chlúdach go hiomlán.
entries.targetTranslation: Maireann Bitcoin a bhfuil cúltaca ceart déanta air tinte, tuilte agus creathanna talún. Tá maoin réadach i mbaol ag gach tubaiste, agus is annamh a chlúdaíonn árachas gach rud.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Tá gach bitcoin comhionann agus in-mhalartaithe - is ionann bitcoin amháin agus bitcoin amháin áit ar bith ar domhan. Tá gach píosa eastáit réadach uathúil le suímh, coinníollacha, agus tréithe éagsúla, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé deacair maoine a phraghasáil agus a chur i gcomparáid.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá gach bitcoin mar an gcéanna agus inmhalartaithe. Tá gach maoin réadach uathúil, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé deacair í a luacháil agus a chomparáid.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Is féidir Bitcoin a cheannach agus a dhíol 24/7 ag aon duine le rochtain idirlín áit ar bith ar domhan. Tá díolacháin eastáit réadach teoranta do cheannaitheorí áitiúla, éilíonn siad próisis fhada le dlíodóirí agus gníomhairí, agus féadfaidh siad míonna a thógáil le críochnú.
entries.targetTranslation: Trádáiltear Bitcoin go domhanda 24 uair sa ló do dhuine ar bith a bhfuil idirlíon aige. Tá díolacháin maoine réadaí teoranta do cheannaitheoirí áitiúla agus is féidir leo míonna a thógáil le críochnú lena gcuid páipéarachais.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Cumasaíonn Bitcoin úinéireacht dhíreach aonair gan idirghabhálaithe, ag cur ceannasacht airgeadais chun cinn do chách. Cuireann eastát réadach a cheannach mar infheistíocht thar do phríomháit chónaithe le hairgeadaíocht na tithíochta, ag caitheamh le tithe mar thráchtearraí seachas dídean. Ardaíonn sé seo praghsanna, laghdaíonn sé inacmhainneacht do theaghlaigh, agus cuireann sé le géarchéim na tithíochta agus na dídeanachta atá ag cur isteach ar go leor tíortha inniu.
entries.targetTranslation: Ligeann Bitcoin úinéireacht dhíreach aonair do dhuine ar bith. Má cheannaítear maoin réadach mar infheistíocht níos faide ná an phríomhcheannáras, ardaíonn sé praghsanna tithíochta, laghdaíonn sé infhaighteacht agus cruthaíonn sé géarchéim tithíochta.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Nuair atá Bitcoin agat, tá úinéireacht dhíreach agat ar an tsócmhainn féin. Nuair atá stoic agat, is leat sciar de chuideachta, rud a chiallaíonn go mbraitheann d'infheistíocht ar fheidhmíocht na cuideachta, cinntí bainistíochta, agus rath gnó.
entries.targetTranslation: Is sócmhainn dhíreach é Bitcoin gur leatsa go hiomlán é. Is sciartha de chomhlacht iad scaireanna — braitheann a luach ar bhainistíocht, ar fheidhmíocht agus ar chinntí nach bhfuil smacht agat orthu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Oibríonn Bitcoin ar líonra díláraithe gan aon phointe aonair teipe. Tá infheistíochtaí stoic faoi réir riosca príomhdhuine - má fhágann an POF nó ceannairí criticiúla eile, má éiríonn siad tinn, nó má dhéanann siad cinntí dona, is féidir le d'infheistíocht fulaingt go mór. Braitheann cuideachtaí go mór ar a bhfoirne ceannaireachta.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl POF ná pointe teipe amháin ag Bitcoin. Braitheann scaireanna go mór ar bhainistíocht — is féidir le drochchinneadh nó imeacht duine tábhachtach an praghas a thitim.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Cinntear praghas Bitcoin go hiomlán ag soláthar agus éileamh an mhargaidh. Déantar praghsanna stoic a mheas go minic ag úsáid cóimheasa P/E (Praghas-go-Tuilleamh), a thaispeánann cé mhéad a íocann infheisteoirí as gach dollar de thuilleamh cuideachta. Is féidir le cóimheasa P/E arda stoic os cionn a luacha a chur in iúl, rud a fhágann go bhfuil sé níos deacra luach cothrom a chinneadh.
entries.targetTranslation: Tagann praghas Bitcoin ó mhargaí oscailte domhanda. Braitheann luacháil scaireanna ar chóimheasa ar nós P/E ar féidir leo scaireanna rótharchéimnitheacha a cheilt.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on global exchanges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 around the world. Stock markets are only open during business hours on weekdays.
entries.currentValue: Trádálann Bitcoin 24 uair an chloig sa lá, 7 lá sa tseachtain ar mhalartáin dhomhanda.
entries.targetTranslation: Trádáiltear Bitcoin 24 uair sa ló ar fud an domhain. Níl margaí scaireanna ar oscailt ach ar laethanta seachtaine le linn uaireanta trádála.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a fixed supply asset with a hard cap of 21 million Bitcoin that will ever exist. This makes it a great inflation hedge. Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.
entries.currentValue: Is sócmhainn soláthair sheasta é Bitcoin le huasmhéid dhian de 21 milliún Bitcoin a bheidh ann go deo. Déanann sé seo cosaint iontach in aghaidh boilscithe de. Tá feidhmíocht athraitheach ag stoic in aghaidh boilscithe - éiríonn go maith le roinnt cuideachtaí le linn tréimhsí boilscitheacha agus tá deacrachtaí ag cinn eile. Níl aon ráthaíocht go gcosnaíonn aon stoc áirithe in aghaidh boilscithe.
entries.targetTranslation: Fágann soláthar seasta Bitcoin ina fhál iontaofa i gcoinne boilscithe. Buaileann roinnt scaireanna boilsciú, ní bhuaileann cinn eile — níl rud ar bith ráthaithe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is an open network that anyone can join and use without permission. Credit card networks like Visa are closed systems controlled by financial institutions that can deny access to anyone they choose.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.
entries.currentValue: Is líonra oscailte é Bitcoin is féidir le haon duine páirt a ghlacadh ann agus é a úsáid gan chead. Is córais dhúnta iad líonraí cárta creidmheasa cosúil le Visa atá faoi smacht institiúidí airgeadais ar féidir leo rochtain a dhiúltú d'aon duine a roghnaíonn siad.
entries.targetTranslation: Is líonra oscailte é Bitcoin ar féidir le duine ar bith páirt a ghlacadh ann gan chead. Is córas dúnta é Visa atá á rialú ag institiúidí airgeadais ar féidir leo rochtain a dhiúltú — go háirithe do dhaoine nach bhfuil banc acu nó nach bhfuil banc ceart acu.

entries.englishValue: Every Bitcoin transaction is on a public, auditable blockchain. Visa runs a closed, proprietary system where customers can't independently verify anything.

entries.englishValueBefore: Credit card companies can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time. Bitcoin cannot be frozen or controlled by any central authority.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can't be frozen by any central authority. Visa can freeze accounts, block transactions, or deny service at any time.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Is é rianú do bhunúis costais an difríocht is mó idir cuntasaíocht do dhollair agus cuntasaíocht do Bitcoin. Fiú má fheiceann tú do ghnó go hiomlán i dtéarmaí Bitcoin, ní mór duit luach dollair gach idirbhirt a thuairisciú ar do cháin.
entries.targetTranslation: Roghnaíonn roinnt gnólachtaí cuid den Bitcoin a fhaigheann siad a choinneáil seachas é a athrú go huathoibríoch. Má tá tú i mbun an chleachtais seo, is é an chéim bhreise ná an bunphraghas a leanúint — luach i ndollair gach íocaíochta Bitcoin an lá a fuarthas é.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: Má úsáideann tú QuickBooks, is féidir leat é seo a dhéanamh go huathoibríoch ag úsáid an bhreiseáin Bitcoin Sync.
entries.targetTranslation: Fiú má smaoiníonn tú ar do ghnó i mBitcoin amháin, teastaíonn ó fhormhór na n-údarás cánach fós go ndéanfaidh tú tuairisciú ar an luach i ndollair. Dea-scéala: níl ann ach dhá uimhir in aghaidh an idirbhirt — an méid Bitcoin a fuarthas agus a luach i ndollair an lá sin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Tarlaíonn boilsciú nuair a phriontáiltear nó a chruthaítear níos mó airgid as an aer. Déanann sé seo d'airgead níos lú luachmhaire le himeacht ama.
entries.targetTranslation: Tarlaíonn boilsciú nuair a chlóbhuailtear nó a chruthaítear níos mó airgid as rud ar bith. Cailleann sé luach ar an airgead i do phóca le himeacht ama — agus is é sin an fáth a n-ardaíonn praghsanna bliain i ndiaidh bliana.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Tá soláthar seasta ag Bitcoin, rud a chiallaíonn nach féidir le haon duine níos mó Bitcoin a phriontáil.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá soláthar seasta 21 milliún bonn ag Bitcoin. Ní féidir le rialtas, banc nó comhlacht tuilleadh a chruthú. Coinníonn do choigilt in Bitcoin a luach le himeacht ama in áit é a chailleadh go ciúin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Tá bainc iolracha SAM tar éis titim sna blianta beaga anuas mar gheall ar rith ar bhainc.
entries.targetTranslation: Le blianta beaga anuas, thit go leor bainc SAM mar gheall ar rití bainc. Nuair a rinne an iomarca custaiméirí iarracht tarraingt ag an am céanna, ní raibh dóthain airgid thirim ag na bainc chun iad go léir a íoc.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: In ionad d'airgead a choinneáil duit, infheistíonn bainc d'airgead agus tugann siad ar iasacht é. Mura n-éiríonn go maith leis na hinfheistíochtaí sin, níl go leor acu chun tú a aisíoc.
entries.targetTranslation: In ionad d’airgead a choinneáil amháin, tugann bainc an chuid is mó de ar iasacht agus infheistíonn siad é. Má theipeann ar na hinfheistíochtaí sin — nó má chailleann taisceoirí muinín — is féidir leis an mbanc titim agus do thaiscí a reo nó a chailleadh.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Agus níl ach $1 ag ciste árachais FDIC as gach $100 atá á árachú acu.
entries.targetTranslation: Le Bitcoin, is féidir leat d’airgead a choinneáil go díreach i do sparán féin. Gan bhanc. Gan idirghabhálaithe. Gan rith bainc.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Murab ionann agus líonraí airgeadais traidisiúnta, ní gá cead chun Bitcoin a úsáid.
entries.targetTranslation: Murab ionann agus cártaí creidmheasa, PayPal nó cuntais bhainc traidisiúnta, ní iarrann Bitcoin cead ar dhuine ar bith.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Ciallaíonn sé sin nach féidir le haon duine tú a stopadh ó Bitcoin a úsáid ar chúis ar bith. Is é an chéad líonra airgeadais é is féidir leat a úsáid gan eagla roimh chinsireacht nó urghabháil.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní féidir le duine ar bith do chuntas a reo, íocaíocht a bhlocáil nó tú a dhíchonnascadh ón líonra. Is é an chéad chóras airgeadais sa stair é is féidir leat a úsáid go saor, gan eagla roimh chinsireacht nó coigistíocht.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Is teicneolaíocht míthuigthe é Bitcoin atá ag tógáil domhain níos fearr.
entries.targetTranslation: Is minic a thuigtear Bitcoin go mícheart, ach déanann sé go leor maitheasa go ciúin ar fud an domhain.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Chuir Bitcoin ar chumas gníomhaithe cearta daonna troid ar son na saoirse, laghdaigh sé astaíochtaí meatáin domhanda, shábháil sé páirceanna náisiúnta, agus go leor eile.
entries.targetTranslation: Chuidigh sé le cosantóirí cearta daonna ina gcuid troda ar son na saoirse, laghdaigh sé astuithe domhanda meatáin ó líonadh talún agus toibreacha ola, chobhsaigh sé eangacha leictreachais agus mhaoinigh sé earraí poiblí ar nós páirceanna náisiúnta.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Ní chaithfidh glacadh le Bitcoin i do ghnó do chuntasaíocht a chur trí chéile. Seo an leagan gairid — móide uirlisí agus saineolaithe a fhágfaidh gan pian é.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Má ghlacann tú le hairgead tirim nó le cártaí cheana féin, is simplí ná mar a cheapann tú é Bitcoin a chur le cuntasaíocht do ghnó. Tá dhá chonair agat: gach íocaíocht Bitcoin a athrú go huathoibríoch go dollair a luaithe a thagann sí (gan chuntasaíocht nua), nó cuid de a choinneáil i mBitcoin (ní mór roinnt uimhreacha breise a leanúint).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Déanann an treoir seo athbhreithniú ar an dá chonair — ionas go roghnóidh tú an ceann a oireann do do ghnó agus go dtosóidh tú ag glacadh le Bitcoin go muiníneach.

entries.englishValue: That's it. The underlying math is identical to how any other appreciating or depreciating asset is accounted for.
entries.targetTranslation: Sin é. Tá na ríomhanna bunúsacha mar an gcéanna le haon sócmhainn eile a théann suas nó síos.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Tá sparáin Bitcoin saor in aisce. Roghnaigh an ceann a oireann do do ghnó — sa siopa, ar líne nó ar shonrasc — agus tosaigh ag glacadh le Bitcoin i gceann nóiméad.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Sparáin do ghnólachtaí a sheolann sonraisc chuig custaiméirí

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Má sheolann tú sonraisc chuig custaiméirí (comhairleoireacht, saorobair, seirbhísí B2B), úsáid sparán atá tógtha thart ar shonraiscí. Íocann an custaiméir an sonrasc Bitcoin i gcúpla cliceáil.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Sparáin do ghnólachtaí a bhfuil foirne fostaithe acu

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Má tá foireann agat a dhéanann díolacháin ag an bpointe díola, roghnaigh sparán a láimhseálann logáil isteach iomadúla fostaithe — ionas go bhfuil a PIN féin ag gach fostaí agus go gcoinníonn tú taifead soiléir ar cé a fuair gach íocaíocht.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Sparáin do ghnólachtaí ar líne

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: An bhfuil tú ag díol ar líne? Nascann na sparáin seo le do shiopa ar líne agus glacann siad le Bitcoin ó chustaiméir ar bith ar domhan — gan aisíocaíochtaí cártaí agus gan cuntas ceannaí ag teastáil.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Sparáin do ghnólachtaí aonair

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Má ritheann tú siopa, caifé, stiúideo nó seirbhís leat féin, oibreoidh gach ceann de na sparáin seo. Roghnaigh de réir má theastaíonn uait íocaíochtaí a choinneáil in Bitcoin nó cuid de gach íocaíocht a athrú go huathoibríoch go d’airgead reatha áitiúil.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Ligeann Strike Business duit glacadh le híocaíochtaí Bitcoin agus Lightning le táillí nialasacha agus socrú láithreach. Tacaíonn sé le híocaíochtaí sa siopa, ar líne agus ar shonrasc, le tiontú uathoibríoch roghnach go d’airgead reatha áitiúil.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Táillí níos ísle, níos mó don ghnó

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Téann íocaíochtaí Bitcoin thart ar na bainc agus ar chuideachtaí cártaí a ghearrann 2-3% as gach díolachán. Coinníonn an gnó níos mó den mhéid a íocann tú — rud a chiallaíonn níos minice praghsanna níos fearr agus seirbhís níos fearr duit.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Socrú láithreach, gan aisíocaíochtaí cártaí

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Socraíonn íocaíochtaí Bitcoin i soicindí, díreach ó do sparán chuig an ngnó. Gan moill laethanta sula scaoileann an banc na cistí, agus gan díospóidí aisíocaíochta costasacha — rud a chiallaíonn gur féidir leis an ngnó díriú ar a chustaiméirí in áit a bheith ag troid le calaois.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Glacadh saor in aisce, oscailte do gach duine

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Gan chonarthaí, táillí míosúla ná táillí tosaithe do ghnó chun Bitcoin a ghlacadh. Agus tá na milliúin úsáideoir Bitcoin ar fud an domhain ag lorg go gníomhach ceannaithe a ghlacann leis — rud a thugann nochtadh saor in aisce don ghnó sin do chustaiméirí nua.

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business
entries.targetTranslation: Cén fáth go bhfuil Bitcoin go maith don ghnó seo

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Trí Bitcoin a ghlacadh, coinníonn an gnó seo níos mó ar gach díolachán, socraíonn sé láithreach gan aisíocaíochtaí cártaí agus sroicheann sé lucht éisteachta domhanda d’úsáideoirí Bitcoin — gach rud gan chonarthaí ná táillí míosúla.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl Bitcoin úsáideach ag an bpointe díola amháin — is foirm airgid níos fearr é a chosnaíonn do choigilt, do phríobháideachas agus do shaoirse idirbheartaíochta. Seo achoimre ghasta.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Rinne tú scanadh díreach ar ghreamán “Bitcoin Accepted Here”. Seo cén fáth gur dea-scéala é — don ghnó seo agus duitse.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Glacann an gnó ina bhfuil tú le Bitcoin — líonra íocaíochtaí nua-aimseartha, foinse oscailte ar féidir le duine ar bith, áit ar bith, é a úsáid, gan go dtógann bainc agus idirghabhálaithe a sciar.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
entries.targetTranslation: Cibé an bhfuil tú i do fhorbróir, i do dhearthóir, i do scríbhneoir nó i d’aistritheoir, tá bealach ann chun cabhrú. Cuirimid fáilte ar leith roimh ranníocóirí is féidir leo ár n-ábhar a aistriú go níos mó teangacha, ionas gur féidir le daoine ar fud an domhain foghlaim faoi Bitcoin ina dteanga dhúchais.

entries.englishValue: Fork the repository, open a pull request, file an issue, or just star the project to show your support. Every contribution helps Bitcoin reach more people.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Is aipeanna saor in aisce iad cliaint Nostr a ligeann duit léamh agus scríobh ar líonra Nostr. Oibríonn siad go léir le chéile — is féidir leat cliaint a mhalartú am ar bith agus do leantóirí agus d’ábhar a choinneáil.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Is prótacal nua díláraithe é Nostr le haghaidh cumarsáide ar líne — níl aon chomhlacht ina úinéir air, tá zaps Bitcoin ionsuite, agus is féidir leat bogadh ó aip go haip gan do leantóirí a chailleadh.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Cad é Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Oibríonn Nostr mar ríomhphost: níl duine ar bith ina úinéir ar an bprótacal, is féidir le duine ar bith aip a thógáil air agus roghnaíonn tú an ceann is fearr leat. Murab ionann agus Twitter nó Facebook, níl aon chomhlacht lárnach ann ar féidir leis tú a chinsireadh, a chosc nó a shrianadh.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Is prótacal nua é Nostr a ligeann duit cumarsáid a dhéanamh ar líne gan eagla roimh chinsireacht, cosc nó laghdú.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Saor le bogadh

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Oibríonn Nostr mar ríomhphost. Níl duine ar bith i gceannas ar phrótacal an ríomhphoist, agus is féidir le duine ar bith cliant a thógáil air (ar nós Gmail, Hotmail, srl.).

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Níl prótacal Nostr á rialú ag duine ar bith ach oiread, agus is féidir le duine ar bith cliant a thógáil air (ar nós Damus, Amethyst, srl.).

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Mura dtaitníonn an chaoi a n-oibríonn cliant ar leith leat, is féidir leat do chuntas Nostr a bhogadh chuig cliant eile gan do leantóirí ná d’ábhar a chailleadh.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin ionsuite

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Tá Bitcoin ionsuite i bprótacal Nostr. Nuair a fheiceann tú ábhar a thaitníonn leat, is féidir leat “zap Bitcoin” a sheoladh chuig an údar go héasca mar bhuíochas.

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ar ardáin láraithe ar nós Twitter agus Facebook, déanann comhlacht lárnach airgead ó d’ábhar. Ach ar phrótacail oscailte ar nós Nostr, is tusa a dhéanann airgead ó d’ábhar féin.
